decisions.reason: The aloe vera line has kept its own dedicated page for two years, which signals continued commitment, and carrying it costs this in-house small-batch producer little while its value is still unfolding.
The hyaluronic serum is close to the core range and still listed after two years, so its option remains cheap to hold, though its low visibility means it has not yet proven strong demand.
The cleansing oil launched only in 2024 and its uncertainty has not resolved; it may also be filling the slot left by the dropped cleansing milk, so keeping this low-cost option is worthwhile.
